mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_VALKYRIE (47), drawn as MONSTER_MODEL_VALKYRIE = 35 (_enum.h:4185), so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster36.bmd. OpenMU Version075 Maps/Atlans.cs names breed 47 'Valkyrie'. docs/atlans-port.md Part B 4.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13799-13806, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_VALKYRIE: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_VALKYRIE); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_VALKYRIE, ...); Scale = 1.1f; Weapon[0] = MODEL_BLUEWING_CROSSBOW; BlendMesh = 0 at BlendMeshLight 1.0, so mesh 0 -- the whole armoured body, gp01 -- is drawn added and never solid (BMD::RenderBody, ZzzBMD.cpp:2242; RenderMesh's blend arm), a glowing figure, and ZzzObject.cpp:1135-1140 holds its light at 1. Its link bones are 30 and 39 (:11996-11998), and it fires arrows as the Hunter and the Orc Archer do (:4831-4835).
right_hand_from: Weapon[0], the Bluewing Crossbow (CrossBow06, already cooked), on Weapon[0].LinkBone 30 -- knife_gdf in Monster36, as in the Devil's and the Vepar's rigs.
rig_from: Seven actions, exported with --actions=all. 41 bones. MONSTER_MODEL_VALKYRIE sets BoneHead 19 and no PlaySpeed (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3653-3659).
sheet_from: Two sheets out of Data/Monster beside the model, decoded under a valkyrie_ prefix: gp01.OZJ (256x256, the body, 638 triangles) -- dark blue-black finned plate traced in gold; gp02.OZT (64x64, 17) -- blue fins, its own alpha a real mask.
sheet_materials_from: The body is plate, but drawn as MU's BlendMesh (`glow`), added and unlit, so its material only names it; the fins a membrane, blended as the Bahamut's.
glow_from: MU's BlendMesh 0 at light 1: the whole body added to the frame, a glowing figure. Ours as the Ice Monster's body is, a glow that still casts half a shadow so it stands on the sand.
soft_alpha_from: gp02.OZT is drawn by MU tested and blended (EnableAlphaTest, ZzzOpenglUtil.cpp:366-393), as the Bahamut's fins.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3653-3659: SetMonsterSound(..., 135, 135, 136, 136, 137), offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 = 210 -- 345 VALKYRIE1 (mValkyrie1.wav) to move, 347 VALKYRIEDIE (mValkyrieDie.wav) to die, 346 to attack and flinch. 346 is SOUND_MONSTER_BALIATTACK2_ (DSPlaySound.h:288), which nothing loads: the arm loads mBaliAttack2.wav into SOUND_MONSTER_BALIATTACK2 (339), so MuMain's Valkyrie shoots silent. mBaliAttack2 is what the arm means, and is used. Wired as valkyrie_* in sounds.json.
islands_from: 6 islands for 655 triangles. Islands 0-2 are gp01, the body (638), plate_steel under the glow; 3-5 are gp02, the fins (17), leather and blended (soft_alpha). They arrived as skin.
